src.core.railway_data.railway_network.set_railway_id_network(railway_map: dict) → None¶

Setter for the static railway network map The network has been built looking iteratively at the known railway id moving from both arrival and departure city By drawing all the railway section, one could have seen which one was useful and which one was not leading to the given city. Once removed manually, the network map has been set to static

src.core.railway_data.railway_network.init() → None¶

Initialize logger and set the static railway network map

src.core.railway_data.railway_network.get_railway_id_from_network(departure: str, arrival: str) → list¶

From city pair from the original SNCF delay dataframe, the main one to work on during this project, retrieve the railway ids after processing railstation names to keep consistency between SNCF datasets (it was not originally the case)

Parameters:

  • departure_city (str) – the departure city of the railway link

  • arrival_city (str) – the arrival city of the railway link

Returns:

the list of railways id linking the departure and the arrival cities

Return type:

list

src.core.railway_data.railway_network.get_railway_data_between_cities(departure: str, arrival: str) → list¶

Build the custom list of data about railway geo points and delay from city pair to be displayed on the Folium map. The mean delay gives the color of the displayed line. Delay and both cities are displayed on hover. Of course, the railway geographical data points are used to effectively draw the polylines.

Parameters:

  • departure_city (str) – the departure city of the railway link

  • arrival_city (str) – the arrival city of the railway link

Returns:

the list of required data to draw railways information on the FOLIUM map

list[0] : railway_id : used only to check consistency list[1] : railway_point_to_draw : the geographical railway data points list[2] : departure : the departure city of the railway link (hover) list[3] : arrival_city : the arrival city of the railway link (hover) list[4] : mean_delay : match the colormap of national delay statistics

Return type:

list

src.core.railway_data.railway_network.get_all_railways_to_draw() → list¶

Build the custom list of data about railway geo points and delay for all the railstation pairs listed in the original SNCF dataset

Returns:

a list of the list of required data to draw railways information on the FOLIUM map for each city pair of the original dataframe. For each railway link, one can find all the following output data:

list[0] : railway_id : used only to check consistency list[1] : railway_point_to_draw : the geographical railway data points list[2] : departure : the departure city of the railway link (hover) list[3] : arrival_city : the arrival city of the railway link (hover) list[4] : mean_delay : match the colormap of national delay statistics

Return type:

list
